nodes.label: db service (Postgres 16)
nodes.rationale: Named volume torquedesk_db preserves Postgres data across container rebuilds.

nodes.label: server service (TorqueDesk Go API)
nodes.rationale: Bound to 127.0.0.1:8081 to match pre-Docker nginx upstream; mounts torquedesk_data at /data.

nodes.label: torquedesk_data volume
nodes.rationale: Holds uploads, weekly ZIP backups, anything written under /data.

nodes.label: Docker Migration Guide
nodes.rationale: Zero-data-loss migration from bare-metal systemd to Docker Compose.

nodes.label: Fixora index.html entrypoint
nodes.rationale: Rebranded TorqueDesk -> Fixora; applies theme pre-paint from localStorage torque-app.

nodes.label: Off-box backup (rclone to Google Drive)
nodes.rationale: Nightly DB dump + uploads + on-box backups to Drive with 30-day retention.

nodes.label: Fixora Favicon (TF Monogram)
nodes.rationale: 32x32 rounded-square SVG favicon with black background; white 'T' and orange 'F' letters forming the Fixora/TorqueDesk brand monogram.
